column1: # Which cells touch which, in the early C. elegans embryo: a time-resolved contact table for
# BioLang v0.4 §7.4 (`contacts:` on the organism block). Rows are `time cell cell [area]`;
# the neighbours of a cell at time t are the latest snapshot at or before t, filtered to the cells
# alive then, so a snapshot may name cells that are not yet born or have already divided.
# WHAT THIS IS, HONESTLY. It is curated from the published geometry of the cleavage-stage embryo,
# not measured contact areas: no time-resolved contact-area table for C. elegans is held locally,
# and the Ma et al. 2021 atlas carries expression per cell per minute, not positions. Every area
# below is 1.0 (touching) or 0.5 (a minor face), which is a statement about topology only. A
# measured table would replace this file without changing a line of any program that reads it.
# WHY THE SNAPSHOT TIMES ARE COARSE. Only the AB divisions have no measured spread (timers.bio, sd
# 0.0); the P lineage's do, so P1 divides at 42 min with the program's seed and at 36 min when every
# timer runs at its mean, and a snapshot keyed to either is wrong for the other. Each snapshot here
# is therefore taken at an AB division and lists the union of the configurations that hold until the
# next one. Aliveness does the rest: a row naming a cell that is not yet born, or has already
# divided, is ignored. A table keyed to the P divisions instead silently loses the P2 signal under a
# different draw of the timers, which is how this was found.
# Geometry and sources:
#   2-cell   AB anterior, P1 posterior; one interface.                    Sulston et al. 1983, Dev Biol 100:64
#   3-cell   AB divides ~2 min before P1; ABp lies between ABa and P1,
#            so ABa has no face on the P lineage.                         Sulston 1983; Priess 2005, WormBook
#   4-cell   the rhomboid: ABa-ABp, ABa-EMS, ABp-EMS, ABp-P2, EMS-P2.
#            ABa does NOT touch P2. This single fact is what makes ABp
#            different from ABa, and it is the fact the program now reads
#            from here instead of naming ABp in the signal.               Priess & Thomson 1987, Cell 48:241;
#                                                                         Mello et al. 1994, Cell 77:95;
#                                                                         Hutter & Schnabel 1994, Development 120:2051
#   6-cell   AB daughters over EMS and P2; only the posterior pair
#            (ABpl, ABpr) reaches P2.                                     Priess 2005, WormBook
#   8-cell   P2 divides into C (dorsal) and P3 (ventral).                 Sulston 1983
#  10-cell   EMS divides into MS (anterior) and E (posterior).            Sulston 1983
#  12-cell   MS reaches ABalp and ABara: the second Notch interaction,
#            which makes anterior pharynx from the ABa lineage.           Priess 2005, WormBook;
#                                                                         Hutter & Schnabel 1994
# time
# --- 2-cell, 0 to 28 min ---
# --- AB has divided (28 min): the 3-cell embryo and then the 4-cell rhomboid ---
# --- the AB daughters (60 min): the 6-, 8- and 10-cell configurations ---
# --- the AB granddaughters (94 min): MS reaches ABalp and ABara ---
